turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: Thank you both for joining. Let us go through the renewal points one by one.

turns.speaker: Thomas Reyes
turns.text: Under the signed agreement the monthly fee is USD 18,000, so the increase is modest.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: The liability cap in the signed agreement is USD 250,000, and we want it higher.

turns.speaker: Thomas Reyes
turns.text: Invoices are payable within forty-five days under the agreement, and that stays.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: Our advice to the client is that the indemnity clause is weak and should not be relied on.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: We will waive the late payment interest for this quarter if you sign this month.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: Please keep us updated on the timetable.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: I will send the revised redline to everyone by Friday.

turns.speaker: Thomas Reyes
turns.text: Harrowgate wants certainty on the liability cap before anything else.

turns.speaker: David Okafor
turns.text: We can accept a liability cap of USD 300,000 for the renewal.

turns.speaker: David Okafor
turns.text: Thirty days' written notice for convenience, as in the signed agreement.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Three of the six directors are present, so we can proceed.

turns.speaker: Anders Holm
turns.text: I declare an interest in the Northbridge Analytics project, because a family member works there.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: Item five is the Project Lantern budget with Northbridge Analytics.

turns.speaker: Anders Holm
turns.text: I vote in favour of the Northbridge Analytics budget.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: The next meeting will be held on 10 September 2026.
